nexscope/billing.instruction: Check current pricing before execution. Do not automatically retry a paid call.

description: Searches Nexscope patents and returns matching publications and the full hit count.

collapseBy.description: Deduplication sort field: APD, PBD, AUTHORITY or SCORE.

collapseType.description: Deduplication: ALL (default), APNO, DOCDB, INPADOC or EXTEND.

offset.description: Offset, 0–19,999; limit + offset must not exceed 20,000; default 0.

queryText.description: Analytics query expression, at most 12,000 characters; supports TACD:, TAC:, TA: and AND/OR/NOT.

sort.description: Sort entries {field, order}; field is PBDT_YEARMONTHDAY, APD_YEARMONTHDAY, ISD or SCORE; order is DESC or ASC.

name: nexscope_patent_search
title: Patent Search
